verdict.rationale: Autumn has no documented AI insights or suggestions feature inside its own dashboard. It does document an official MCP server that lets external AI assistants reach billing, customer, balance and log tools, including request-log investigations. That gives an indirect route to AI-generated insights from your data, but only through an outside assistant. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, any documented example of AI analysis of billing or usage data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
